tools.name: api2pdf_html_to_pdf
tools.description: Render an HTML string to a PDF using the headless-Chrome engine. Returns a { FileUrl } link (valid ~24h) by default. Great for invoices, reports, and letters produced as HTML. BILLED per document. Api2Pdf API: POST /chrome/pdf/html.

tools.name: api2pdf_url_to_pdf
tools.description: Fetch a web page by URL and render it to a PDF using headless Chrome. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). Use extraHTTPHeaders to pass auth for a protected page. BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /chrome/pdf/url.

tools.name: api2pdf_markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Render a Markdown string to a PDF using headless Chrome. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /chrome/pdf/markdown.

tools.name: api2pdf_html_to_image
tools.description: Render an HTML string to an image using headless Chrome. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h) by default, or base64 bytes with output_binary:true. BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /chrome/image/html.

tools.name: api2pdf_url_to_image
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a live web page by URL using headless Chrome. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /chrome/image/url.

tools.name: api2pdf_wkhtml_to_pdf
tools.description: Render an HTML string to a PDF using the wkhtmltopdf engine — an alternate to Chrome that supports a table of contents (pass enableToc / tocOptions inside `options`). Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /wkhtml/pdf/html.

tools.name: api2pdf_office_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert an office document (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, ODT, and many more) at a URL to a PDF using LibreOffice. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /libreoffice/any-to-pdf.

tools.name: api2pdf_merge_pdfs
tools.description: Merge several existing PDFs (given as URLs, in order) into a single PDF. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /pdfsharp/merge.

tools.name: api2pdf_compress_pdf
tools.description: Compress an existing PDF (given as a URL) to reduce its file size. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /pdfsharp/compress.

tools.name: api2pdf_extract_pages
tools.description: Extract a range of pages from an existing PDF (given as a URL) into a new PDF. `start`/`end` are 0-based page indices; omit `end` to extract a single page. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /pdfsharp/extract-pages.

tools.name: api2pdf_add_password
tools.description: Encrypt an existing PDF (given as a URL) with a user password (required to open) and an optional owner password (controls permissions). Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /pdfsharp/password.

tools.name: api2pdf_convert_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a document or file (given as a URL — PDF, Office docs, and more) to Markdown text via MarkItDown. Great for feeding a document's contents back to an agent. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h). BILLED. Api2Pdf API: POST /markitdown.

tools.name: api2pdf_generate_barcode
tools.description: Generate a barcode or QR code image. `format` is the symbology (e.g. 'QRCode', 'Code128', 'PDF417', 'DataMatrix') and `value` is the string to encode. Returns a { FileUrl } (valid ~24h) by default, or base64 with output_binary:true. BILLED. Api2Pdf API: GET /zebra.

tools.name: api2pdf_get_balance
tools.description: Return the remaining balance / usage for the configured Api2Pdf account. Api2Pdf API: GET /balance.

tools.name: api2pdf_get_status
tools.description: Return the current Api2Pdf service / health status. Api2Pdf API: GET /status.

tools.name: api2pdf_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a previously generated file by its ResponseId (the `ResponseId` returned in a generation response). Api2Pdf API: DELETE /file/{ResponseId}.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "api2pdf_add_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: api2pdf_url_to_pdf, api2pdf_add_password · Private data: api2pdf_html_to_pdf, api2pdf_office_to_pdf, api2pdf_compress_pdf, api2pdf_add_password, api2pdf_convert_to_markdown, api2pdf_delete_file · Public sink: api2pdf_html_to_pdf, api2pdf_url_to_pdf, api2pdf_markdown_to_pdf, api2pdf_html_to_image, api2pdf_url_to_image, api2pdf_wkhtml_to_pdf, api2pdf_office_to_pdf, api2pdf_merge_pdfs, api2pdf_compress_pdf, api2pdf_extract_pages, api2pdf_add_password, api2pdf_convert_to_markdown · Destructive: api2pdf_generate_barcode, api2pdf_delete_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: api2pdf_url_to_pdf, api2pdf_add_password · Private data: api2pdf_html_to_pdf, api2pdf_office_to_pdf, api2pdf_compress_pdf, api2pdf_add_password, api2pdf_convert_to_markdown, api2pdf_delete_file · Public sink: api2pdf_html_to_pdf, api2pdf_url_to_pdf, api2pdf_markdown_to_pdf, api2pdf_html_to_image, api2pdf_url_to_image, api2pdf_wkhtml_to_pdf, api2pdf_office_to_pdf, api2pdf_merge_pdfs, api2pdf_compress_pdf, api2pdf_extract_pages, api2pdf_add_password, api2pdf_convert_to_markdown · Destructive: api2pdf_generate_barcode, api2pdf_delete_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
